The brain daemon restart protocol now routes through `launchctl kickstart -k` rather than a direct Popen spawn. To restart the daemon, run:

```
launchctl kickstart -k <service-target>
```

The `-k` flag kills any running instance before relaunching, making this an atomic stop-and-start. Direct Popen spawning is no longer used for restarts.
